title: C2 Analysis Result (VIS to AI, filesystem)
description: One JSON file per analysed image, written to data/analysis/{patrol_id}/{image_id}.json. VIS signals completion for a patrol by writing an empty data/analysis/{patrol_id}/_COMPLETE marker file (not itself JSON, not covered by this schema). See 01-interface-contracts.md §C2.

captured_at_ms.description: Same clock basis as C1's ts_ms — required for image-to-telemetry zone matching.

image_path.description: Relative to the data root, e.g. images/{patrol_id}/{file}.jpg.

image_quality.description: Drives image selection (spec §7). Always present, even for images with zero detections.

state.description: Closed set. A fifth value, typo, or translated variant is a contract violation — AI raises rather than guessing (rule C2.3.1).

count.description: Instances of this class+state in this image. Not deduplicated across frames (rule C2.3.4) — the aggregate is an observation count, not a plant count.

confidence.description: Null permitted only when state is 판단불가.
